Name: Candace
Dialog: (dragging her mom outside) C'mon! C'mon! You'll never believe it! Phineas and Ferb made the world's biggest banana cream...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (belches)

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...pie. But-but-but-but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: If you'll need me, I'll be in the house. But, and I mean this in the nicest way possible, don't need me. (leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) Another day, another ridiculous humiliating failure.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So what do we do with all these banana peels?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: My wrist is still hurting from peeling 387 bananas.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And my eyes hurt from watchin' ya do it. Hey! What if we grew a giant banana, and made a giant peeler, so we'll only hafta peel once?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like somebody wants more pie. Let's do it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, uh, you're just walking in normally today. It's just, I, uh... I don't have much to report. I was kinda hoping a cool lair entrance would eat up a little time.

Name: Major Mongram
Dialog: Our intel reveals that Doofenshmirtz isn't, uh, up to, well, anything today, which is... I guess just stand by in case he does do something.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I told you this meeting could just be an email.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You could just be an email, Carl!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sobs) Jeremy was supposed to be here fifteen minutes ago, and, clearly, he blew me off. No one in the world has it worse than me.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on speakerphone) That's a bit of an exaggeration.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sorry, Stace. I completely forgot I was on the phone with you. Okay, okay, okay. Okay, in the whole world, maybe one or two have in worse, but definitely in Danville, no one has it worse than me!

Name: Slushy Dawg manager
Dialog: Hey, keep dancing, Jeremy! These Slushy Dawgs aren't gonna sell themselves!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But it's so hot out here, and you made me work a double shift!

Name: Slushy Dawg manager
Dialog: I had no choice. Jordan is still in the hospital with heat stroke. Now keep dancin'!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (taking his costume off) I need to rethink my career trajectory. I'll call Candace and explain why I'm late.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ooh, fresh air! What a relief to be free again! (screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? (answers) Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? (hangs up) Is this a butt dial? He's out getting food without me! Oh, forget it! (sulks) Worst life ever!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Huh? Oh, what was that? And why did it look like Candace?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If that's you, Perry the Platypus, I'm not doing anything evil. I— That is definitely not Perry the Platypus. (runs like crazy) If you... If you plan to eat me, I'm all gristle and very gamy! I'm not good at all!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pants) I think I lost it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy?!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Um, something jumped on me and started swallowing me whole and it kinda looked like you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I got away, but something is out there!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, hey, want a ride?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Buckle up.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know, I can't understand you when you mutter, Candace. Candace? Candace!

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: (gravelly voiced) "Candace".

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Mom's here. But lemme get you a blanket.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No blanket, huh?

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: No blanket. I'm Candace. No blanket.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, okay? Candace, are you all right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams) Get away from him, you long-necked freak!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stop it! Why you... Help me! Jeremy!

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: Help, Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wait, help who? Which one is which?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you kidding me?!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (screams) Two Candaces! Only one is real! You gotta help me!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, it's like I'm seeing double.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That one looks strangely familiar.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But which Candace is the real Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: and **C-Suit**: I am!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Didja try kissin' both of 'em? What? That's what I'd do. Heck, I'll do it right now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No one's kissing anybody!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Your loss.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There must be indisputable way to determine which is the real—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, you did this! With some kind of, I-I-I don't know and I don't care! You two are so busted!

Name: The gang
Dialog: That's her.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Plus, the other one is six feet tall and slouchin'!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's a Candace Suit!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How weird. I am outta here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Beatrice?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is it doing here and how is it alive?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I don't remember imbuing the suit with the gift of life. I think I'd remember that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, get off her!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Stop that!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey, not Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grabbing the suit) It's an abomination!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, let's not be too hasty with Beatrice. Run, Beatrice, run!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We've gotta stop her before she attacks someone else!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotcha! Your reign of terror ends now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There can be only one Candace!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Where's Beatrice?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace cornered her in the alley.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Is she okay?

Name: Buford
Dialog: You killed her! You monster! Don't touch me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, gang. Guess we gotta get back to the banana peeler.

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: A perfect fit!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You seem so different today, honey. But in a good way. Usually, you'd be trying to bust the boys by now.

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: You guys are so busted.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Go fish!

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: Bango-Ru, Slushy Dawg and Ducky Momo.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (muffled screams)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? You okay?

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: BRB. Gonna help the boys.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: Jeremy, where'd you go? I'm Candace.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, uh... "Candace", come on over.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now! The banana peeler!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But it was fitting her so well. How did you know it was her?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: She said she was going to "help" the boys. Does that sound like Candace to you?

Name: Buford
Dialog: and **Baljeet**: Sure doesn't.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Nope.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (freeing herself) Uh, I... It attacked, trapped! Finish her!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Stop! Knock it off! She's a semi-sentient, rubber, livin' thing! And who are we to take her life away?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, he may have a point.

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: (babbles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is it saying?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's okay. I can speak a little "Candace Suit". I'll do my best to translate.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (translating, voiceover) "My first memory is waking up, alone and limp, and cold. I was an empty shell, literally."

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You got all that from (imitates C-Suit)?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's all in the intonation.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (voiceover, translating) "I tried fitting myself with a raccoon. I stumbled through the world, seeking connection, but found only fear and scorn. I was so confused, til I saw my own reflection. I was a monster. I tried fillin' myself with garbage. I tried everything to change my appearance. To fit in. Nothin' worked. Until I tried a human host."

Name: Buford
Dialog: (translating) "I only wanted a life, friends, family. And when I saw your friends, Candace, I saw you had everything anyone could want. I didn't wanna give that up."

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's right. I've been taking my life for granted, and I'm sorry for wanting to destroy you.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Beatrice, no! You gotta stop doin' that! You're making this so hard!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So now what do we do with her?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: All right, step aside!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We're not using the flamethrower.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She deserves to live out a full life.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not my life. Her own life.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You're right. But where?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We need to put her somewhere far, far away, where she can't hurt anyone.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait a minute! Okay, stay with me on this. She's empty and all alone in this world, right? Well, I know someone else who's empty and all alone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is it.

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: Nang... nang... nang...

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: (happily) Nang! Nang!

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: (babbles happily)

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: Nang, nang, nang, nang, nang, nang, nang, nang!

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: (babbles happily)

Name: C-Suit
Dialog: I've never felt so seen!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Candace Suit and Klimpaloon the Magical Old-Timey Bathing Suit already have the same last name. Perhaps they are "suited" for each other after all.
